text:
𝗦𝗟 𝗟𝗘𝗔𝗗 𝗕𝗬 𝟭𝟰! 🇱🇰😳

Sri Lanka are 241/6 at tea on Day 3 in Rawalpindi, 14 ahead overall.
Kusal Mendis 53; Dinusha 46*, Rathnayake 17*.

From 98 all out to a lead. Can they set a target? 👇
